rationale: The current assessor-class record identifies this parcel as vacant residential land, and an MLS listing dated 2025-11-06 describes it as a cleared, unimproved lot. Oakland also verified a blight condition in 2019. These support likely site vacancy, but do not establish when vacancy began or that it continued without interruption through today.
vacancy_duration: Unknown. A 2025-11-06 listing describes a cleared lot; no source establishes the start date or continuous duration.

evidence.detail: PropertyShark's 2025-2026 tax and parcel record identifies APN 4-81-10 at 1468 8th Street as use code 1000, 'Vacant Residential Land, Zoned 4 Units or Less.' Alameda County defines use code 1000 that way and cautions that its codes are maintained for assessment purposes, not as continuously updated occupancy determinations.

An MLS-syndicated listing for 1468 8th St (MLS 41116859), dated 2025-11-06, identifies the property as lots and land / unimproved land and describes a cleared, level 3,400-square-foot parcel. Listing status is time-sensitive; this does not prove the parcel remains vacant today or that it was vacant continuously before then.

Oakland's Q4 2019 Code Enforcement report records case 1902122 at 1468 8TH ST: violation verified on 2019-05-20 for vegetation over five feet and a fallen fence. This supports poor site condition at that time, but is not by itself proof of vacancy.

limitations: No dated source establishes the first day of vacancy or continuous vacancy duration.
No current 2026 field observation, utility record, or current code-enforcement result was found.
The assessor use code is an appraisal classification and may not be continuously updated; it is not proof of who is present at a property.
